title: Rational_Potato X/Twitter — Occurrence-Level Biblical Reference Index 2024–2026
status: comparative-scriptural occurrence index built from dated public-post compilation
purpose: Implement the Biblical Overlap Atlas research target to index Tim's own public posts occurrence-by-occurrence while separating explicit-at-time biblical vocabulary from later structural comparators.

method.source_direction: Start with the dated public post. Only then attach a biblical text or comparator.
guardrails: A biblical comparator does not prove prophecy fulfillment, supernatural identity or historical equivalence.
If the post itself names Jesus, Messiah, Zion, Judas, Satan, Jacob, Ezekiel, Communion, Tree of Life or another biblical term, mark that as explicit at time.
If only a structural resemblance is found later, mark it as a later comparator and do not backdate it.
Do not force every garden, tree, father, son, dog or mountain occurrence into a Bible reference.
Preserve textual mismatches instead of silently correcting the source wording.

high_value_findings: Biblical borrowing begins in the supplied public record before the mature God/Father architecture: October 2024 already contains Chosen/Gentile and die-for-your-sins Potato wordplay.
December 2025 marks a qualitative shift: scriptural titles and Christ/Son vocabulary are fused with Father, North and World-Axis roles rather than remaining isolated jokes or devotional phrases.
April-May 2026 specializes the Son as passage/death-return function: Bread, Door, Tomb, Resurrection, Tree of Life and Jacob appear in dense relational clusters.

June-August 2026 increasingly uses recognizable biblical idioms as active public interpretive language: wide road, breath into nostrils, stumbling blocks, principalities, LORD/Satan, needle's eye, Communion, move mountain, Cornerstone and Zion.
September 7 adds a different kind of overlap: not title matching but an ethical grammar of stewardship, service, protection and care for creation.
